Key Features

Everything You Need to Manage HR

From attendance tracking to AI-powered analytics, 3Boxes HRMS covers every aspect of modern human resource management.

Multi-Company Management

Manage multiple group companies, branches, and entities from a single dashboard with unified control and reporting.

Employee Lifecycle

Complete hire-to-retire management — onboarding, transfers, promotions, resignations, and alumni tracking.

Attendance & Leave

Biometric, GPS, and shift-based attendance with geofencing, overtime, WFH snapshots, and smart leave workflows.

Payroll & Compliance

Flexible salary structures, statutory compliance, bank files, payslips, and multi-country payroll processing.

Recruitment ATS

Post jobs, track candidates through a visual pipeline, AI resume screening, interview scheduling, and offer management.

Performance Management

360° reviews, goal setting, OKRs, continuous feedback, calibration, and performance analytics dashboards.

AI-Powered

AI chatbot for HR queries, resume screening, predictive analytics, burnout detection, and anomaly insights.

Smart Workflows

Visualize Your HR Workflows

Every HR process is mapped, automated, and trackable. See how 3Boxes HRMS transforms manual chaos into streamlined pipelines.

From hire to productive team member in days, not weeks
